ios.desc:
The smartest way to plan your time.

AllTime puts your whole life on one timeline. Your calendars, your workouts, your meals, your goals, your to-dos, all in one place you can drag, plan, and actually keep up with.

YOUR WHOLE DAY, NOT AN EMPTY GRID
Other apps just show you a blank calendar. AllTime gives you the Me tab: a live snapshot of your whole day in one place. What's coming up, how you slept, your workout, what you ate, your focus time, and your streaks at a glance. Set it as your home screen and open straight to you.

ONE CALENDAR, EVERY ACCOUNT
Apple Calendar, Google, and Outlook sync in real time. No more app-switching. No more double-bookings. No more missed events because you forgot which calendar it was on.

A CALENDAR THAT KNOWS YOU
AllTime suggests the right thing at the right time, pulled from your goals, your habits, and your free gaps. Tap a suggestion to add it, or drag it onto your day and drop it right where it fits. Planning that feels like your calendar gets you.

JUST TELL IT WHAT YOU NEED
"Lunch with Tim at noon tomorrow." Done. "Block 90 minutes for deep work this afternoon." Done. Type it or say it out loud, and AllTime adds it for you, at a smart time, with a daily briefing written automatically.

BUILD YOUR WHOLE DAY IN A FEW TAPS
Stuck on where to start? Open Build My Day, pick your mood, energy, and free time, and AllTime maps out a full day for you from your real goals, habits, and nearby places. You just tap add.

DESIGNED FOR HOW YOU ACTUALLY MOVE
Pinch to zoom your timeline. Swipe through weeks. Drag events with your finger. Drop a small event onto a bigger one to group it. Switch between timeline, checklist, and a kanban board with a tap. Built from the ground up for iPhone, Mac, and Apple Watch.

A CHECKLIST THAT ROLLS WITH YOU
Today, Upcoming, and Completed in one list that never loses your unfinished stuff at midnight. Set priorities and due dates, drag to reorder, or flip to a kanban board. See your family and friends' to-dos in your own list and help keep everyone on track.

HEALTH AND NUTRITION, BUILT IN
Snap a photo of your meal or just type it, and get instant nutrition. It's honest too: it shows a calorie range with how sure it is, not a fake exact number. Workouts auto-sync from Apple Health and Garmin and land right on your calendar. Track your cycle with smart predictions, all in one place.

GOALS WITHOUT THE GUILT
Set goals and see where your time really goes. Want to cut something out instead? Avoidance go
